title: Okula Düşen Damla
author: Seda Aksoy Evren
description: CAN A SINGLE DROP CHANGE THE WORLD? On the first day of school, a mysterious girl joins the class. Everyone senses she is different, but no one knows who she really is. Before long, her classmate Derin decides to follow her and uncovers the door to a big secret. It’s a secret powerful enough to change not only their lives, but the future of the entire world. Realizing the danger of the climate crisis, Derin and her new friend quickly inspire the whole school to take action. Together, they create imaginative projects to protect water and earn the chance to take part in an unforgettable trip. What kind of project would you design?
english_title: The Drop That Fell on the School
